digest.component_or_area: test suite - Jira DataCenter transport and pagination
propositions: Five tests contain assertions that cannot fail due to tautologies, missing implementations, or overstated docstrings that do not match the test body
PAT-repr test constructs a transport with no credential and asserts a hardcoded PAT string does not appear in repr, ignoring that the transport never receives the PAT and defines no __repr__

_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() helper hardcodes live transport source as input, so teeth test re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate, remaining green even if the predicate regresses

validate_assignee_exists test asserts only membership via hasattr(), duplicating the parametrized presence test, while no assertion exists for the return-value contract (username string vs bool vs accountId)
Rate-limit sweep asserts total <= 1 client calls per member, which is satisfied by total == 0 when a member raises before reaching the client, never exercising the 429 branch
Backend registry error test asserts only a class relationship between BackendRegistryError and KeyError, not the raising behavior of select_backend() itself
